description: Adds a comment to the specifed document element or array of Runs.

params.description: The element where the comment will be added. It may be applied to any element which has the *AddComment* method.
params.name: element

params.description: The user ID of the comment author.
params.name: userId

returns.description: Returns null if the comment was not added.

signature: AddComment(element: ApiRun[] | DocumentElement, text: string, author?: string, userId?: string): ApiComment
